species: Standard Herbaceous Fern (e.g., Dryopteris or Polypodium type)

flora: Small Fiddlehead (tightly wound, thinner and smoother than the tree fern version)
Fern Leaflet underside (close-up showing rows of brown, circular sori/spore cases)
A creeping Rhizome (horizontal root-like stem with small roots and an emerging frond)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; focus on the contrast between the green leaf and the textured brown spore dots; clean and educational layout.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition showing: 1. A delicate emerging fiddlehead. 2. A close-up of the underside of a leaf showing spores (sori). 3. The underground rhizome system. 4. A small, healthy cluster of ground fronds.
visual_logic.ground: Rich, moist soil with fine bits of organic debris like tiny twigs and moss.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, diffused daylight to ensure all small botanical details are sharp.
